pages.text: A Resonating wand is used to start the crafting process in $(item)Astral Sorcery$() crafting tables.$(br2)Required knowledge:$(br)$(l:sim_2/knowledge/1_as)Лунное озарение$()

pages.title: светящийся верстак
pages.description1: Drop a $(item)Crafting Table$() into $(l:sim_2/resources/0_surface_level)Liquid Starlight$() to create the $(item)Luminous Crafting Table$().$(br2)This workbench can harness $(item)Starlight$() to craft items with Magical properties.$(br2)Later workbench $(item)Tiers$() require a multiblock structure.$(br)(Can be found in $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$())

pages.text: The $(item)Lightwell$() can draw out the $(item)Liquid Starlight$() that collects in $(l:sim_2/resources/1_minerals_and_ores)Aquamarines$() and $(l:sim_2/resources/1_minerals_and_ores)Rock Crystals$().$(br2)You will need to create a fair amount of $(item)Liquid Starlight$() to progress in this $(item)Simulation$().

The $(item)Linking Tool$() can redirect $(item)Starlight$() in $(item)Floating Crystals$().$(br2)A $(item)Starlight Crafting Altar$() multiblock is necessary to craft this item. You may need a $(item)Spectral Relay Structure$() feeding your altar to cover the starlight requirement.$(br)$(item)Spectral Relays$() are covered under Exploration in the Astral Tome.

This ore is absolutely packed with $(item)Star$() power. It's created by pointing a concetrated beam of starlight towards an $(item)Iron Ore Block$().$(br2)You can find $(item)Floating Crystals$() in the larger shrines found on the $(item)Lunar Plane$(), use a $(item)Linking Tool$() to direct their natural $(item)Starlight$().

Do not forget to remove the ceiling of the large shrine.$(br2)The crystal needs a view of the sky to craft the $(item)Starmetal Ore$().$(br2)(If all conditions are met and it still does not work, $(item)restart$() the game)$(br2)Works faster during the nighttime. Consider setting up a $(l:sim_2/helpful_stuff#night_ritual)Night Ritual$() by the crystal.
